title: Backtest trade CSV and retention
summary: trade_log=True writes backtest trade CSV under trade_log_file_path. Default keep_days is 3. This is not strategy self.trace, and not a live-trade log.
narrative:
Pass trade_log=True on qt.run(..., mode=1) to record each simulated fill. The files are backtest CSVs (trade_log_*, trade_summary_*, and related value_curve_* when enabled). The directory is trade_log_file_path (relative, absolute, or ~/...). Default trade_log_keep_days is 3: after a new process imports qteasy, older files in that directory are cleaned once. Set keep_days to None or <=0 to keep everything; call qt.rotate_trade_logs() for a manual cleanup.

Typical columns cover time, symbol, side, price, size, amount, and fees. They line up with loop_result and oper_count on the result object.

self.trace / trace_log records intermediate variables inside realize()—that is a strategy card, not this CSV. Simulated-live order logs are a live-boundary topic (later coverage), not this backtest file layout.
python_code:
import qteasy as qt
op = qt.Operator(strategies='dma', signal_type='PT', run_freq='d')
result = qt.run(op, mode=1, asset_pool='000001.SZ', invest_start='2020-01-01', invest_end='2023-12-31', trade_log=True)
print('trade_log enabled')
risk_notes: Ask explains file layout only. Writing logs still requires a confirmed backtest run.
